messages:
Ivy Chen: Noticed weird behavior on streaming resume: when client opens a second connection the upstream sometimes replays last window, causing duplicates and charge mismatches. Repro in staging.
Marco Diaz: Is this replay full-request or partial-frame?
Ivy Chen: partial frames. sequence numbers overlap after path switch.
Olga Sokol: Two quick approaches: (A) resume handshake where client sends last-seen seq/token, upstream skips <= that; (B) edge-side short TTL dedupe cache for (rid,seq).
Marco Diaz: Handshake adds round-trip but deterministic. Cache avoids RTT but needs memory and cross-edge consistency is hard.
Ivy Chen: For multi-edge resume we can't share state cheaply. I prefer handshake as opt-in for SDKs, plus edge dedupe as safety net.
Olga Sokol: Agreed. Suggest: 1) SDKs emit x-rid and monotonic chunk-seq; 2) add optional Resume-Init frame with last_seq on new path; 3) ingress keeps tiny LRU of (rid,seq) TTL=30s to avoid immediate duplicates; 4) metric duplicate_chunk and billing dedupe spec.
Marco Diaz: Also need clear failure model: if resume handshake missing, accept duplicates but mark billing samples for manual reconcile.
deploy-bot: deploy: ingress-streaming v0.5 rolled to canary (5%).
Ivy Chen: Action items: Marco -> RFC draft with handshake wire format and perf tradeoffs. Olga -> prototype LRU dedupe and metric. I'll collect staging pcaps and sample traces.
Marco Diaz: I'll include compatibility notes for mobile SDKs and opt-in flag.
Olga Sokol: I'll add an alert when duplicate_chunk_rate > 0.05% for critical paths.
Ivy Chen: repro snippet: ```
[client] new-conn resume rid=R7 last_seq=41
[upstream] emits seq=41..44
[proxy] sees seq=41 twice -> duplicate_chunk metric++
```
Ivy Chen: Thanks, will follow up with tickets.
